entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: Individual leaders and decision-makers whose choices causally drive the war end-state

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Country or entity the person leads

attributes.name: stance
attributes.description: Current stated position on war termination (e.g. freeze-first vs final-deal-first)

attributes.name: influence_tier
attributes.description: High/medium/low influence over the forecast outcome

entity_types.selection_rule: Named individuals who personally decide war aims, negotiation posture, or mediation policy
anti_examples: Analysts, journalists, pollsters commenting on the war (sources, not actors)

entity_types.name: Government
entity_types.description: Sovereign governments and national finance/defense blocs shaping war, sanctions and aid

attributes.name: stance
attributes.description: Position on war termination and sanctions sequencing

attributes.name: influence_tier
attributes.description: High/medium/low influence over the forecast outcome

entity_types.selection_rule: Executive governments or national ministries holding war-relevant decision power
anti_examples: Multilateral bodies like the EU or NATO (Organization); individuals (Person)

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Institutions, alliances, military commands and central banks that act on the war and macro outcome

attributes.name: org_kind
attributes.description: Kind: military command, defense ministry, alliance, central bank, other

attributes.name: stance
attributes.description: Current policy posture relevant to the forecast

attributes.name: influence_tier
attributes.description: High/medium/low influence over the forecast outcome

entity_types.selection_rule: Formal institutions that decide policy rates, sanctions, aid, defense posture or battlefield tempo
anti_examples: Media outlets, think tanks, data providers cited as sources

entity_types.name: Other
entity_types.description: Non-state actors such as shadow-fleet operators and insurers gating Russian export flows

attributes.name: stance
attributes.description: Posture toward sanctions enforcement and Russian trade

entity_types.selection_rule: Diffuse non-state commercial actors whose behavior materially conditions the forecast
anti_examples: Named private firms better modeled as Organization; abstract concepts
levers: continue or halt Russian oil carriage

entity_types.name: MarketAsset
entity_types.description: Tradeable prices and macro series the forecast must price (Brent, TTF, gold, rates, spending)

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Commodity, safe haven, rate, inflation or spending aggregate

attributes.name: unit
attributes.description: Quotation unit (USD/bbl, EUR/MWh, USD/oz, %, USD bn)

attributes.name: resolution_source
attributes.description: Official series used for settlement (ICE, EIA, Eurostat, IMF)

entity_types.selection_rule: A specific priced instrument or official macro series named in the forecast deliverables
anti_examples: Abstract notions like 'market sentiment'; actors influencing prices

entity_types.name: SanctionsRegime
entity_types.description: Legally effective sanctions and relief instruments (packages, waivers, licenses, price cap)

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: Sanctions package, executive waiver, Treasury license, maritime ban

attributes.name: issuer
attributes.description: Issuing authority (EU Council, US Treasury, OFAC)

attributes.name: effective_window
attributes.description: Entry into force and expiry dates

examples: Oil price cap and shadow-fleet measures
entity_types.selection_rule: A specific legally effective or pending sanctions instrument, not a general policy stance
anti_examples: General diplomatic positions (actor stances); narrative claims about sanctions decay

entity_types.name: WarStateScenario
entity_types.description: The five war end-states on the forecast continuum with attached probabilities

attributes.name: state_label
attributes.description: One of the five continuum states

entity_types.selection_rule: One of the five explicitly defined end-states of the war continuum
anti_examples: Individual battles or daily events; abstract 'escalation risk'

entity_types.name: MacroeconomicDriver
entity_types.description: Structural transmission channels linking war state to prices: fiscal strain, manpower, storage, s...

attributes.name: driver_kind
attributes.description: Fiscal, manpower, energy-infra, industrial capacity, election-cycle

attributes.name: binding_threshold
attributes.description: Level at which the driver becomes binding for a scenario shift

examples: Russian fiscal position (3.2% deficit, $50/bbl fiscal-rule cutoff)
EU gas storage (74% full, lowest since 2018)
entity_types.selection_rule: A measurable structural constraint or channel that transmits war state into market outcomes

edge_types.name: OPPOSES
edge_types.description: Adversarial stance or armed/diplomatic opposition between actors

edge_types.name: INFLUENCES
edge_types.description: One actor exerts pressure or leverage over another's decisions
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source pressures or shapes target's choices

edge_types.name: SANCTIONS
edge_types.description: Imposes or maintains sanctions instruments on a target actor

edge_types.name: FUNDS
edge_types.description: Provides financing, loans or budgetary support to another actor

edge_types.name: PARTNERS_WITH
edge_types.description: Formal cooperation or alliance partnership between actors

edge_types.name: SUPPLIES
edge_types.description: Provides goods, materials or export revenue support to another actor

attributes.name: goods
attributes.description: What is supplied (dual-use goods, oil carriage)

edge_types.name: SUPPORTS
edge_types.description: Material, military or political backing of one actor by another

edge_types.name: COMPETES_WITH
edge_types.description: Rivalry or divergent policy tracks between actors

attributes.name: domain
attributes.description: Domain of rivalry (sanctions track, currency policy)

edge_types.direction_semantics: Source competes or diverges from target (symmetric)

edge_types.name: BACKS
edge_types.description: Endorses or underwrites another actor's policy framework or budget path

edge_types.name: DEPENDS_ON
edge_types.description: Reliance on another actor for critical capabilities, financing or political survival

attributes.name: dependency_kind
attributes.description: What is depended on (weapons, intelligence, fiscal backing)

analysis_summary: 该预测问题以俄乌战争的五种终局状态为核心定价驱动，要求对2027年底的Brent、TTF、黄金、欧元区通胀与利率及欧洲防务支出做概率加权定价。主体阵容由2位个人领导人（泽连斯基、普京）、5个政府行为体（美国政府、德国政府、中国政府、英国政府、俄罗斯财政集团）、8个组织机构（欧盟、北约、欧央行、美联储、OPEC+、乌俄军事与财政机构）以及影子船队等非国家行为体构成。本体保留种子四类主体类型，并新增四个领域专属类型：MarketAsset（被定价的市场与宏观序列）、SanctionsRegime（法律生效的制裁与豁免工具）、WarStateScenario（五种战争终局情景）与MacroeconomicDriver（财政、人力、储气等传导约束）。关系层保留全部13个种子关系类型以对齐已注入图谱，并新增CAUSES、TRIGGERS、CONSTRAINS三条因果边，使战争状态→市场价格的传导链（含sign/magnitude/lag属性）成为可检索的预测机制。媒体与智库（Reuters、ISW、Kiel等）仅作为信息来源（tier 3），不建模为能动主体。
